name: Tier-2 Error Log Branching
description: Deterministic branch classification for build and runtime failures

error_class.instructions: What is the primary root cause category of this error log?

criteria.syntax_compile: TypeScript/Python syntax errors, unresolved symbols, missing types
criteria.lint_formatting: Biome, Ruff, ESLint, or formatting rules violations
criteria.dependency_missing: ModuleNotFoundError, npm ENOENT, package not installed
criteria.timeout_deadlock: Execution timeout, process hang, infinite retry loop
criteria.out_of_memory: OOM killer, heap exhaustion, CUDA out of memory, VRAM allocation failure
criteria.network_partition: Connection refused, socket hangup, Tailscale packet drop, DNS error
criteria.permission_auth: Access denied, 401/403, missing SSH key, elevated privileges required

requires_human_intervention.instructions: Does this error require human operator intervention (e.g. physical hardware or secret password)?
